note: Reviewed org identity. Keys under `decisions` are FACEIT team ids; each maps to the org it belongs to, over [valid_from, valid_to) when those are set (ISO 8601; absent = for all time). Outside its window a team id is itself, by the name it carried then. A team id whose names are several organisations' eras carries one mapping per era under `windows`. A team id absent from this file stays unmapped and is queryable as itself. `rejections` are pairs that were reviewed and turned down; they are never proposed again. Edit by hand or with `python -m owcsmuse orgs decide` / `orgs reject`.
